assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: master composition for a landscape mobile RPG lobby, ultra-wide 19.5:9 landscape illustration. Reference images 1 wizard, 2 guardian, 3 witch, 4 archer are approved identities and exact hand-painted cute fantasy style. Preserve recognizable faces, big but restrained eyes, small adventurer proportions, clothing design/color/material quality. Paint a warm, inhabited adventurers' riverside CAMP TERRACE beneath a broad tree, canvas shelter at far right, a distant waterfall/forest valley. Camera at slightly elevated human eye level, natural perspective, warm afternoon sunlight upper left. FOUR different casual actions, connected socially in one place, not a line-up and none posing at camera: left-middle seated silver-armored guardian with violet cloak on low wooden bench carefully cleaning sword, shield resting beside bench; center-left blue-hat brown-haired wizard leaning over a modest round wooden camping table studying an unfolded map, spiral staff nearby; center-right red-bob purple-hat witch sitting on stool at table's other side, reading book with small tea cup, rabbit hat pin; right-middle blue-haired elf archer in approved opaque layered violet skirt/leather top, both anatomically coherent legs and original boots, casually seated against wooden railing checking bow string. Make their heights/gestures overlap naturally with chairs/table, correct feet on ground, clear faces, coherent contact shadows, same rendering as approved art. Table shared by wizard and witch. Keep FOUR characters and furniture inside central 78% width; no characters in bottom 17% (UI zone), and keep top 12% mostly calm canopy/sky for header. Lowest foreground is empty stone terrace; right lower corner has quiet dark tent/ground for a small departure UI later. Preserve landscape depth; party occupies ~50% of illustration height so faces visible at phone size. Refined painterly fabric folds, metal, wood, hair. No magic particles, floating emblems, glowing circles, decorative sigils, text, logos, UI, watermark or extra people. Natural everyday preparations, warm companionship, premium game concept art. Output wide panoramic illustration.
